question: With per-curve six-rung grids derived from the observed v13b failure directions and an estimator robust to the observed one-sided family noise, is D(2)>D(5)>D(20) evaluable in Pythia-160M on UltraChat?

authority.new_program_not_amendment: v16 does not alter or rescue the immutable G13 or G13B verdicts. It is the newly designed prospective study required by v13b's registered no-further-regrid rule.
forbidden_now: create a v16 result root, attempt directory, launch manifest, queue, or controller
start or reserve an H200 process
recenter or extend a v16 curve after any v16 outcome
future_launch_prerequisites: a clean pushed descendant preserving this scientific contract
a frozen robust analyzer and loss-blind 612-cell manifest
byte-identical model and materialized UltraChat inputs on execution nodes
a separate explicit launch authority created before any v16 loss exists

noise_diagnostics.rule: Both finite values remain scientific data. Their one-sided incidence and amplitude are included in gatesim rather than censored.

common_protocol.primary_outcome: fixed 1024-row UltraChat endpoint NLL per supervised token

center_rule.accepted_v13b_curve: center at the measured v13b fitted eta_star
center_rule.rationale: The failed edge becomes the +0.5 rung for a lower failure or the -0.5 rung for a higher failure, leaving three newly registered rungs in the observed failure direction.

T20_mu0.source_rule: 0.1754097492953639*sqrt(2); the v13b negative-curvature vertex is not used as truth

grid_construction.immutability: All 36 eta decimals are exact. No rung may be clipped for being large, moved, extended, or removed after registration.

seeds_and_cells.why_17: The measured one-in-three Pythia divergence profile does not clear P_evaluable>=0.80 with the conventional three-seed mean. Seventeen seeds plus a rung median and 70% valid-refit threshold is the smallest prospectively tested robust design retained here that clears the bar under the full registered gatesim.

analysis_contract.rung_estimator: median endpoint NLL across all 17 registered seed values at the exact rung
analysis_contract.scientific_divergence_rule: Every finite value remains in the ordered sample and evidence package. The median is the registered estimand; no value is deleted, winsorized, or replaced.
analysis_contract.curve_fit: OLS loss=a*x^2+b*x+c through the six rung medians, x=log2(eta)
analysis_contract.acceptance: a>0 and the unconstrained vertex lies strictly inside [min_registered_x-0.5,max_registered_x+0.5]; report INTERIOR versus NEAR_BRACKETED and never clip the vertex

bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric seed bootstrap; one shared 17-index resample recomputes every rung median and all six quadratics
bootstrap.intervals: equal-tailed 95% percentile intervals for log2 D and adjacent differences; invalid refits are counted

gate.name: G16
gate.SECOND_FAMILY_MONOTONE: all 612 cells are valid, all six point fits are accepted, at least 7000 shared refits are valid, D(2)>D(5)>D(20), and both adjacent log2-D 95% interval lower endpoints are >0
gate.SECOND_FAMILY_NONMONOTONE: complete evaluable evidence that does not meet every monotonicity condition
gate.SECOND_FAMILY_NOT_EVALUABLE: missing/invalid evidence, any unaccepted point fit, or fewer than 7000 all-six valid refits

analysis_contract.no_regrid: Any NOT_EVALUABLE v16 outcome remains final for v16. It cannot authorize a seventh rung or an in-program estimator change.

gate_feasibility.noise_model: curve-specific robust core scales from v13b plus paired one-in-three one-sided spikes at their measured 129.757010 and 39.377260 NLL amplitudes
gate_feasibility.interpretation: The declared monotone alternative places truth at the registered centers solely to test gate mechanics. Its extreme T20 center ratio is not scientific evidence or a prediction that the family law is true.

completed_cell_requires: exact source, model, data, command, seed, T,H,S,mu,eta identity
four learners each complete exactly S steps
exactly 4*T strict-quorum fragment commits and matching telemetry
hashes for all command, result, evidence, tape, telemetry, and checkpoint artifacts
allowed_retry_reasons: registered timeout without a valid endpoint
evidence_and_retry.retry_unit: all six eta rungs sharing T,arm,seed
